title: glyceria distans subsp. conferta
intro: Glyceria distans subsp. conferta, commonly known as Fringed Mannagrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria distans subsp. conferta are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are said to aid in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycerin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
